Name: Ephah, Concubine of Caleb
Summary: Concubine of Caleb who bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:46: Concubine of Caleb who bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ephah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
